name: Hinoyama Sakura
source:
A cool young man of few words, with an overwhelming singing skill. He joined the band during high school because of Seri's request. He has a lot of pride and confidence in music. He's a heavy smoker, and smokes frequently.

[Translation of [url=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/vita-liar/chara.html]official website character profile[/url].]
